skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of e-commerce, including business models, transaction processes, and the application of information technology and telecommunications in e-commerce.
Apply knowledge of e-commerce to real-world scenarios, such as transactions with end customers and businesses.
Analyze and evaluate solutions for implementing e-commerce activities, including hardware, software, electronic payment, and cybersecurity.
Understand and utilize various models of e-commerce transactions, such as B2C, B2B2C, and B2B.
Collect and synthesize information on e-commerce, legal regulations, and reports on e-commerce development.
Develop teamwork skills, including communication, listening, and questioning.
Demonstrate the ability to independently accumulate knowledge and experience, and improve professional skills.
Evaluate and choose appropriate solutions for implementing e-commerce activities.
Understand and apply digital marketing strategies in e-commerce.
Understand and apply cybersecurity measures in e-commerce.
Understand and apply online payment systems in e-commerce.
Understand and apply government e-commerce models and infrastructure.
